<!-- gate-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the gate catalog and the checker's spec; edit those, not this block -->

A response recorded from a real system (`@recorded:`) is of the version the project speaks, and within its max_age.

| Propriedade | Valor |
| --- | --- |
| Verificação | `recording-current` |
| Confronta | `test` |
| Bloqueante por padrão — projeto novo | sim |
| Bloqueante por padrão — projeto existente | não — informa |

## Como declarar

```yaml
gates:
  - name: recording-current
    on: [test]
    check: recording-current
```

Fonte: [verificação](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/recording_current.go) · [sua spec (em inglês)](https://github.com/co2-lab/anchors/blob/main/internal/gate/recording_current.spec.md)
